title: Nuncio Cesare Alberico Lucini (Madrid) to the Secretariat of State, 13 Oct 1767 (AAV Segr. Stato Spagna 304, DECODE R120)

steps.what: DECODE R120 and sibling R121 fetched with the session cookie: 4 page images, MEG's transcription, Lasry's key and his R121 decryption.
Lasry's reconstructed key (DOC_R120_D3314) applied to MEG's figures: 'tumulti ... monarchia ... sollevazioni che succedono in diversi'.
Cipher lines re-read from the full-resolution image; line 1 slip corrected (in-te-r-n-i).
Unassigned or misfitting groups set from context and alphabetical order: 63 = se (also fixes two places in Lasry's R121 text), 03 = chi, 8061 = qual, 8099 = zion, 8700 = anno.
8107 (between 8099 and 8140 Camera; a name in A-Ca, perhaps America) left open.
Web search for an edition of Lucini's 1767 despatches: none found.

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 77 tokens, 36 types, it-modern order 4: reading -1.86 per letter; random keys -3.639 (z 5.8); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -1.816 (mean -1.872, z 0.3); annealer on the real text -1.728. Verdict: underdetermined.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -1.86; polyphony 0.0; 1 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -1.728

outcome.method_basis: Lasry's key, rebuilt from sibling R121 and attached to R120's own DECODE record (DOC_R120_D3314, Oct 2020), was applied to MEG's digit transcription; R120's own passage had not been decrypted before.
outcome.notes: 81 of 82 cipher tokens given a value; 8107 open. The sentence continues on the next leaf, not imaged.

credits.note: key reconstructed from sibling R121, attached to R120's DECODE record

prior.where: Lasry's reconstructed key (from sibling R121) attached to the DECODE record, Oct 2020; R120's own cipher passage not decrypted anywhere found

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
